description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Notifying that the objections will be received for the the intention of making an Order regarding the Marine Transport and Operational Services Trade under the Wages Boards Ordinance, until 24.10.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a notice under the Wages Boards Ordinance regarding the intention to make an order for the Marine Transport and Operational Services Trade. It contains regulatory content about applying wage board provisions to specific worker categories, making it primarily about legal/regulatory matters rather than government structure, personnel, or other specialized categories.
